name: Mango Leaf Disease Image Dataset
description: This dataset contains mango leaf images for mango leaf disease detection and classification research using image processing and deep learning techniques. The dataset consists of eight classes: Anthracnose, Black Spot, Cutting Weevil, Gall Midge, Healthy, Insect Damage, Powdery Midge, and Red Rust.The images are organized into training, validation, and testing subsets for machine learning experiments. The dataset is intended for academic research, image classification, computer vision, and the development of automated mango leaf disease detection systems. Researchers can use this dataset to train and evaluate deep learning models for mango leaf disease classification. Users are encouraged to verify the image labels and check for duplicate or near-duplicate images when creating independent training, validation, and testing splits.
